mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the receiving and sending parts was most worthwhile because the arrows showed a signal travelling along a cell and a chemical message crossing to another cell.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the receiving branches was fairly predictable: their picture already showed how they fit the cell bodies.

surprise.text: The final tissue included supporting cells and fatty fibre coverings, although we hadn't built them separately; their jobs weren't explained here.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless. The later combinations were the only offered options, but their connections to the goals were clear.

continue.text: I would continue: seeing the complete signal path was interesting, and I'd like to see what the nervous tissue does next.
